item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 05/Jul/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The southwest monsoon will bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea in the next couple of days. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening in the latter part of this week, the weather over southeastern China will improve gradually and it will be hot. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Aere will move across Kyushu and Honshu of Japan in the next couple of days and transform into an extratropical cyclone gradually.
